criteria.text: Provides security solutions specifically for public cloud infrastructure
criteria.rationale: Differentiates cloud-focused vendors from general cybersecurity vendors that target endpoints, networks, or on‑premises environments.

criteria.text: Enables customers to discover security issues in public cloud infrastructure
criteria.rationale: Separates companies that actively identify cloud vulnerabilities or misconfigurations from firms that only provide complementary services (e.g., consulting, threat intelligence) without cloud scanning capabilities.

criteria.text: Delivers its security product as a cloud-hosted SaaS platform
criteria.rationale: Filters for vendors that offer a cloud-native software platform rather than on-premise appliances, professional-services-only offerings, or purely open-source projects.

criteria.text: Targets business or organizational customers rather than individual consumers
criteria.rationale: Ensures peers are B2B/cloud-enterprise oriented, excluding consumer-focused security apps or developer utilities that are not sold to organizations.

criteria.text: Focuses on securing cloud infrastructure resources (IaaS/PaaS) rather than endpoint devices or on-premises hardware
criteria.rationale: Distinguishes vendors that secure cloud resources and configurations from vendors whose primary scope is endpoint protection, network appliances, or legacy on-prem security.
